notes.title: New Gene and Limb Attribute
notes.content:
[h1]Content Updated:[/h1]

1. Add special effect to elemental damages.
[list]
  [*] Ice: Reduce 50% move speed.
  [*] Poison: Keep doing damage in a short period.
    [*]Fire: Keep doing damage in a short period.
    [*]Thunder: Increase  damage taken by 30%
[/list]

	1. Add green, blue and purple quality to limbs.
[list]
[*]Green has 20% to 50% more attribute than white.
[*]Blue has one more attribute than green.
[*]Purple has two more attribute than green.
[/list]

notes.title: Fresh Body v0.1.42 Now Available!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26765442/003c2b78deccd38add51847e1bb572d5c4ff7e5d.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26765442/1d847c396b2faba57a7a93bed4f2ba1f7fd3dc38.png[/img]

[h1]The new chapter is still in progress, almost 80% has been finished. And this patch is mainly focus on the game control, which have been totally changed.[/h1]

1.We have modified the  control mode of the game. Now the arrow keys are used to control the direction of attack.

[h1]WARNING: Do not change the default key bindings. There are some bugs on it. We will fix them as soon as possible.[/h1]

2.About 120+ maps have been changed. There will be multiple doors on a single map.

3.Added 5 special maps, in which you can get limbs beyond your progress of the game.

4.Lower the attack of monsters, and raise the health point of them.

5.Most attack and skills can be used when you are moving now, But the role's move speed will have a 45% reduce. We think this will add some control skill for the game.

This is our first update of 2017, we have made some bug fixes and adding a new Chapter with new bodies, skills for you to enjoy. Thank you for your helping and we look forward to create more funny bodies and additional parts of limbs in 2017.

[b]Happy Fresh New Year and Happy with Fresh Body![/b]

[h1] Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add The Ice Chapter, where you will meet the painful animals and the mysterious unknown in the Ice Blood Temple.
[*]Add 16 new enemies, all can be pieced and made as part of your body.
[*]Add 40+ new fresh bodies. Try to collect all of them to accomplish your monster handbook.
[*]Add 40+ new skills with some new features. give them a try.
[*]Add 18+ achievements. Defeat the new huge bosses to achieve them.
[*]Change the base value of attack, health and defense.
[*]Add special effect to the third attack of normal attacks. Give it a chance to make bleed, stun, heal and kncokback effect.
[*]Reduce the cooldown of normal attacks to make them more smooth.
[*]Change the font in UI and Dialog make them easier to read.
[*]Make all monsters to be exploded after the boss dead.
[/list]

[h1] Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where loots will drop in unreachable places.
[*]Fixed bug where the blood of the elite half body zombie not blink to make it self different with the normal one. 
[*]Fixed bug where the skill Throw Meat can not be casted on walking.
[*]Fixed bug where a wrong sound is triggered when first enter the map.
[*]Fixed bug where some text become super huge.
[*]Fixed bug where game data not be saved as designed when player is in the camp.  
[*]Fixed bug where the hunter zombie is sucked in the woods. 
[*]Fixed bug where thunder talent not increase the cirtical rate as designed. 
[*]Fixed bug where the gold cost to repair a body not visible on the UI. 
[*]Fixed bug where the energy cost of skills not visible on the Tips.   
[*]Fixed bug where the tips are viewed on a wrong posiition.  
[*]Fixed bug where horror points not be  cleaned when pass through the Doom Door.
[*]Fixed bug where the flies can not attack and damage player as designed.
[*]Fixed wrong description of skills and bodies .
[*]Fixed bug where the client crashed.
 [/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.04b has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26765442/bcc76513750822cf7146a93e36081b3126520263.png[/img]
Greetings Chirpies! 
Today we are excited to bring you some bug-fixing focused patch and new funtion.
You can see which version number you're running in the lower right corner of the main menu, if you're not sure that you've gotten it. 
1.04b - Patch Notes:
* Redesign the film animation (Last time, some player cannot understand our story. So our artist create a better one)
* Improve the skill funtion, so it's easier to play.
* Custom gamepad button, You can edit the button.

For next week, we'll focus work on finding/fixing most important causes for memory problem. so if that's your case and you're not having fun, please pass by the forums and share your impressions.ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Fresh Body's Incoming Update
notes.content:
We have collected many suggestions and fixed some serious bugs. Thank you everyone.
Fresh Body will continue to evolve every second.

[h1]Here are the features we will work on first:[/h1]
[list][*]  Add gamepad support.
[*]  Training monsters, make them smarter.
[*]  Remake story animation.
[*]  Add more randomness.
[*]  Improve data and skill balance.
[*]  Improve skill effects.
[/list]
We'd like to say thank you to your support . We're very happy to see everyone enjoying the result of the work we put into it! ːsteamhappyː
